description: Dice Club (provably fair on-chain dice, program `DiCe5Vcp…`): the house's live rules and limits — edge, minimum stake, chance range, free bankroll, the largest stake it takes at common chances, how many bets wait for the keeper (the table closes at 10), and the seed-chain commitment. Pass `chance` (win chance in %, e.g. 50) to quote it, plus `amount` (COOK) to check a specific bet. Members only: names the NFT collection a bettor must hold (Cookie Chads) and, for `wallet` (default: yours), whether it holds one. No key needed.

amount.description: stake in COOK; with `chance`, checks whether the table takes this bet

chance.description: win chance in percent (0.01–98.99, at most two decimals) to quote

wallet.description: address or .cook name to check membership and balance for; default: yours

name: get_dice_table
title: Dice Club table
